parts.rubric: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a time. You will hear a teacher giving information about an English class.
parts.title: English class

gaps.explanation_es: Lo deletrea: B, E, doble L.
«The class is on Mondays and Thursdays».
«It starts at six o'clock in the evening».
«The book for this class costs twelve pounds».

segments.speaker: teacher
segments.text: Hello. Welcome to the English class.

segments.speaker: teacher
segments.text: My name is Mrs Bell. That's B, E, double L.

segments.speaker: teacher
segments.text: The class is on Mondays and Thursdays. It starts at six o'clock in the evening.

segments.speaker: teacher
segments.text: We are in room nine. Please bring a notebook and a pen.

segments.speaker: teacher
segments.text: The book for this class costs twelve pounds. You can buy it in the school shop.

segments.speaker: teacher
segments.text: See you on Monday!

parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B or C). You will hear Anna talking to her friend Mark about his new flat.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: Hi, Mark. Do you like your new flat?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Yes, I do. It's small, but it's very nice.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: How many rooms are there?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: There is a bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom. Four rooms.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: Is it near your work?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: No, it isn't. But it's near the station. I go to work by train.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: Is there a garden?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: No, but there is a big park in my street. I run there every morning.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: How much is it?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: It's five hundred pounds a month.

segments.speaker: anna
segments.text: That's good. Do you live alone?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: No, I live with my brother, Jack. He is a student.

questions.prompt: How many rooms are there in Mark's flat?
questions.explanation_es: Dormitorio, salón, cocina y baño: «Four rooms».
No está cerca del trabajo, «but it's near the station».
No tiene jardín, pero hay un parque grande en su calle y corre allí.

questions.prompt: How much is the flat every month?
questions.explanation_es: «It's five hundred pounds a month».
«I live with my brother, Jack».

parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear Lucy talking to her dad about a family picnic. What food or drink will each person bring?

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: Lucy, the picnic is on Sunday. What is everybody bringing?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Mum is making a big salad.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: Good. And your brother Tom?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Tom is bringing bread. He works in a bakery, so it's easy for him.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: And Grandma? Is she making a cake?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: No, not this time. She is cooking a chicken.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: Lovely. What about Uncle Bill?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: He has apple trees in his garden, so he is bringing apples.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: And you, Lucy? Water?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: We have water at home. I am going to buy some orange juice.

questions.explanation_es: «Mum is making a big salad».
Tom trabaja en una panadería y lleva pan.
Esta vez no hace tarta: «She is cooking a chicken».
Tiene manzanos en el jardín y lleva manzanas.
Agua ya hay en casa; ella va a comprar zumo de naranja.
